result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. I didn't run the command by hand or add a test for the new name. `mvn -o -pl cli test` passes.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview just before `updateLandscape`.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch accepts either name. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name you typed, so `updateLandscape -help` prints exactly what it did before.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` as the main name and `updateLandscape` as the older name, kept for existing scripts.
